name: 第5屏·尺寸参数
purpose: 刻度尺实拍矩形锁定加参数表；参数逐字核对，不过不能导出
prompt: Size and specification screen. The upper part is the locked real photograph of the product next to a ruler (do not touch it). Below it, on a charcoal background, a clean two-column specification list with hairline dividers, label on the left in light grey, value on the right in off-white, set like a printed spec sheet. One line of small caption text at the bottom.
